map.执行后自动生成解读。: Analysis appears after you run the tool.
map.下面的解读由本页面在你浏览器里对刚才的结果做本地分析得出，不上传、不调用额外接口: The analysis below is computed locally in your browser from the result you just got. Nothing is uploaded and no extra requests are made. For troubleshooting reference only, not a substitute for professional judgment.
map.最近一次成功结果只保存在你本机浏览器（localStorage），不上传。可展开: Your last successful result is stored only in this browser (localStorage) and is never uploaded. Expand a row to compare the current output with the previous one. Clearing site data removes the record.
map.以下工具与本页面常一起使用：: Tools commonly used with this page:
map.用 Cloudflare 测速端点：预热后多次小请求取延迟中位数与抖动，多轮下载: Use Cloudflare speed endpoint: warm-up, repeated small requests for latency/jitter, multi-round downloads for median download speed.
map.先预热连接，再发 10 次小请求取延迟中位数与抖动；随后对 1/5/10MB 各: Warms up the connection, takes 10 small requests for median latency and jitter, then downloads 1/5/10MB twice each for median download speed. Endpoint is Cloudflare public __down.
map.尚未有运行记录，点击上方「开始测速」开始。: No run history yet. Click "Start test" above to start.
map.这是专业测速吗？: Is this a professional speed test?
map.不是，仅用公共端点做粗略估算，受节点、时段、网络拥塞影响较大。: No, a rough estimate from a public endpoint, affected by node, time and congestion.
map.会下载约 30MB 测试数据（多轮累加），请留意移动网络流量。: Yes, about 30MB of test data in total — watch mobile data usage.
map.测速时要做什么？: What should I do during the test?
map.保持页面在前台、避免同时占用带宽，结果更稳定。: Keep the page in the foreground and avoid competing bandwidth for steadier results.
map.检测会向你输入的目标地址或公开接口发起请求，结果只在本地展示，页面不保存查询记录: Checks send requests to the address you enter or to public endpoints; results are shown locally only and no query history is saved on the page. Conclusions are for troubleshooting reference and do not replace professional judgment.
map.本页不向 speed.cloudflare.com 或任何 CDN 拉取测试文件: This page does not download test files from speed.cloudflare.com or any CDN. Automatic tests generate large traffic, are affected by CDN/concurrency/cache and send requests to third parties; use your carrier official speed page or a trusted tool, repeated in the same time window.
map.运营商官方测速页或你信任的工具，本页不代测: Carrier official speed page or a trusted tool; this page does not test
map.下行/上行、延迟、抖动、丢包、测试时段: Down/up speed, latency, jitter, loss and test window
map.有线与 Wi‑Fi 分开，避开同时占用带宽: Separate wired and Wi-Fi; avoid concurrent bandwidth use
map.为什么页面不测速？: Why does the page not run a speed test?
map.自动测速会消耗大流量、把请求发往第三方 CDN，且结果受节点与缓存影响；本页改为: Automatic tests consume large traffic, send requests to third-party CDNs and are affected by nodes and cache; this page provides method and record fields instead.
map.怎样测得更准？: How can I test more accurately?
map.用运营商官方测速页或可信工具，同一时段多次测试；有线与 Wi‑Fi 分开，关闭下: Use the carrier official speed page or a trusted tool, repeated in the same window; separate wired and Wi-Fi and stop downloads/video during the test.
map.不够。延迟、抖动和丢包直接影响视频会议与游戏体验，应一起记录并与套餐、路由器协商: No. Latency, jitter and loss directly affect video meetings and games; record them together and compare with your plan and router negotiated rate.
